title: Desk-Break Neck, Shoulder and Forearm Reset
summary: A short sequence of gentle stroking for the shoulders, posterior neck, and forearms.
goal: Take a calm break after prolonged static work.
startingPosition: Sit stably, lower the shoulders, and place both feet on the floor.
instructions: Gently work the back of the neck.
Stroke the forearm from wrist toward elbow.
direction: Over the shoulders, posterior neck, and forearms.
warning: Stop self-massage with pain, numbness, weakness, dizziness, radiating sensations, or other unusual symptoms.
